annotations.title: Email verification, verify email address: deliverability, disposable and domain risk

description: Verify an email address in one call: syntax, whether the domain exists and has mail servers (MX), disposable and role addresses, free-provider flag, SPF and DMARC, and the sending domain's age and trust flags, rolled into one verdict (likely-deliverable, risky or invalid) with reasons. It does not contact the mail server, so it cannot confirm one mailbox exists. Use to clean a lead list, screen a sign-up or check a contact before outreach. Example: email=alex.morgan@stripe.com. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
